data.title: Housing form due for exchange programme
data.summary: Musterfield Exchange Programme wrote on 2 February 2026 about your housing application. The completed housing form is due on 03/06/2026, and later forms go on the waiting list.
data.explanation: The exchange programme confirms your accepted place and asks you to return the completed housing form. The date is printed as 03/06/2026, which could mean 3 June or 6 March 2026. The letter is in English and the sender is in Germany, so I've assumed 3 June, but please confirm with the programme. Forms that arrive after the date go on a waiting list, so you could lose a housing place. No payment is requested.
